title: Azure Pipelines Guidelines manifest
description: Machine-readable index of every guideline. Downstream MCP servers, linters, fixers, and LLM/RAG pipelines consume this file as the structured source of truth. The markdown files under /guidelines remain the human-readable content; this manifest adds stable IDs, severity, scope, tags, detection hints, and fix guidance.

$schema.description: Optional relative path to this schema, for editor validation.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the manifest schema, independent of the repository release version.

generatedBy.description: Tool and mode that last wrote derived fields, e.g. 'scripts/build-manifest.mjs sync'.

guidelines.description: One entry per guideline markdown file under /guidelines.

severity.description: Recommendation strength. Maps to the title/filename prefix. Suggested lint levels: do->error, do-not->error, avoid->warning, consider->info.

scope.description: Azure Pipelines YAML element the guideline applies to.

detectionHint.description: A heuristic a downstream linter can use to flag a likely violation. This repository does not run the engine; it only describes what to look for.

kind.description: regex: match against raw YAML text. yaml-path: a path/key expression into parsed YAML. heuristic: natural-language rule for an LLM or custom check.

pattern.description: The regular expression, YAML path, or natural-language description, depending on 'kind'.

appliesTo.description: Scopes where this hint is relevant. Subset of the guideline's applies_to.

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic message shown when the hint matches.

fix.description: Remediation guidance for a detected violation.

autofixable.description: Whether a deterministic automated fix is realistic. If false, remediation needs human or LLM judgement.

exampleRef.description: Section of the guideline markdown that holds the canonical good pattern, usually 'Example'.

id.description: Stable unique identifier. Never reused after a guideline is renamed or removed.

title.description: Title without the emoji, e.g. 'CONSIDER: Configuring retries in tasks'. Mirrors the markdown H1 minus the emoji.

summary.description: The one-line summary sentence from directly under the markdown H1.

path.description: Repository-root-relative path to the guideline markdown file.

url.description: Canonical GitHub URL taken from the guideline's reference block.

appliesTo.description: YAML elements the guideline governs. Hand-authored enrichment.

tags.description: Controlled-vocabulary keywords for grouping and semantic search.

related.description: IDs or relative paths of related guidelines, derived from the markdown 'Related guidelines' section.

detection.description: Detection hints for the downstream linter. Hand-authored enrichment.

usefulSources.description: External references from the guideline's optional 'Useful sources' section.
